sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioners have sought for quashing of the FIR and the complaint in Hubbali-Dharwad City Women Police Station Crime No.60/2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as 'the IPC', for short) and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry NC: 2023:KHC-D:13396 Prohibition Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'DP Act', for short) on the file of the learned III Additional Civil Judge and JMFC Hubballi.

2. On the complaint by respondent No.2, a case came to be registered against the petitioners (accused Nos.1 to 5) in Crime No.60/2023 by Hubballi-Dharwad City Women Police Station for offences under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of DP Act.
The petitioners have sought quashing of the said proceedings.
3. An application is filed under Section 320 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The said application is signed by the petitioners 1 to 3 and their counsel and respondent No.2 and her counsel.
Petitioner Nos.1 to 3 are present and respondent No.2 is also present and they are indentified by their respective counsels.
The said application is supported by the affidavit of respondent No.2.

There is dissolution of marriage of first petitioner with respondent No.2 in O.S.
No.39/2022.

As per the terms of the said memorandum of settlement, respondent No.2 has NC:
2023:KHC-D:13396 no objection for quashing the FIR in Crime No.60/2023 of Hubballi-Dharwad City Women Police Station.

The same is mentioned in condition No.5 of the memorandum of settlement which is contained in the decree passed in O.S. No.39/2022.
4.
Respondent No.2 is present before the Court and submits that she has voluntarily entered into compromise and there is no force or coercion on her to enter into compromise.
5. In view of the above, the complaint and the FIR in Crime No.60/2023 of Hubballi-Dharwad City Women Police Station, are quashed.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
